description: Energy layers and assessments: Syria is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Syria. Energy data (2003-2010) including access to electricity, energy production, sources, use, fossil consumption consolidated from data.worldbank.org. Coverage: Syria. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Syria. Its tags are energy, facilities-infrastructure. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLS. The portal shows 2018-08-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Other. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
